visual_action: The video starts with a close-up on a young Black man's face as he speaks. It cuts to a screenshot of a 2016 tweet from Hillary Clinton's account, featuring a black-and-white childhood photo of her with the text 'Happy birthday to this future president.' The video then cuts back to the young man's face, which zooms in with a frustrated expression. A black screen with the text 'Only some of us can be President' appears, followed by a montage of clips of Donald Trump dancing on a stage at a rally, with the same text overlaid.

cast.name: Hillary Clinton
cast.evidence: A screenshot of a tweet from her verified account '@HillaryClinton' is shown, featuring a childhood photo of her.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Multiple clips of him dancing on stage at a rally are shown.

Only some of us can be President

spoken_summary: The video uses audio from a popular skit where a person tells a student named Andrew he can be anything he wants. When Andrew says he wants to be president, the person tells him to 'try a little bit smaller.' Andrew indignantly replies, 'You said I could be anything I want.' The audio then transitions to the song 'U Can't Touch This'.
audio_music: The video begins with dialogue from a comedic skit. At the 6-second mark, the audio abruptly cuts to the iconic, upbeat 90s hip-hop track 'U Can't Touch This', which plays over the footage of Donald Trump dancing, creating a celebratory and triumphant mood.
editing_pacing: Fast-paced cuts between a skit, a tweet screenshot, a reaction shot, a text screen, and a montage of rally footage, typical of meme formats.
cultural_references: The video uses audio from a well-known Vine skit, which is also referenced by the '#vine' in the caption.
The song 'U Can't Touch This' by MC Hammer is used as a prominent backing track.
central_claim: The video mocks Hillary Clinton's failed 2016 presidential aspiration by contrasting it with Donald Trump's victory.
intended_effect: To make the viewer laugh at Hillary Clinton's expense while celebrating Donald Trump.
